english.title: Employ person subject to immigration control 16 or over employee not granted leave to enter / remain in UK
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) employed a person subject to immigration control who had attained the age of 16, who had not been granted leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom and who did not satisfy the conditions specified in an order made by the Secretary of State, namely **(.. SPECIFY THE CONDITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(1)(a) and (4) of the Asylum and Immigration Act 1996.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
employed person subject to immigration control under 16
who had not been granted leave to enter/remain in the UK
who did not satisfy conditions specified in an order made by Secretary of State

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence wording is now OBSOLETE - replaced by offences under the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006.

It is a defence for a person charged with an offence under this section to prove that before the employment began any relevant requirement of an order of the Secretary of State under subsection 8(2A) was complied with.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
